issue: Missing required fields not identified to user
actual: Submitting Add Transaction with empty Description and Amount blocks creation (dialog stays open, row count unchanged) but shows no error message, no red/invalid field styling, and no toast notification identifying the missing description or amount.
evidence: Dialog innerText and body text contain no 'required'/error text after submit attempt with blank Description/Amount.

actual: Filled Description and Amount, left Category as default placeholder 'Select category' (not selecting any option), submitted 'Add Expense'. The transaction was created successfully (row added: 'Aug 25, 2026 CS23 Test Expense No Category — -$25.00') with a blank Category cell, and no error was shown identifying a missing category.
evidence: New row's Category cell is empty in the transactions table.

Created Income transaction: date 2026-08-25, description 'QA Test Sale - Widget Order', amount 1234.56, category 'Sales Revenue', reference 'QA-REF-001', notes 'QA automated test note', Tax Related toggled on. Row created: 'Aug 25, 2026 QA Test Sale - Widget Order Sales Revenue QA-REF-001 +$1,234.56 ✓'.
Newly created transaction row shows date, description, category, reference, amount, and tax status exactly as entered.
When Type=Income, category dropdown only listed income categories (Sales Revenue, Consulting, Interest Income, Other Income). Selected 'Sales Revenue' was retained on the created transaction.
Toggled Tax Related switch to true before creating; new transaction shows ✓ in Tax column.

issue: Editing a transaction silently clears its category
actual: Opened Edit dialog for an existing transaction whose category was 'Sales Revenue'. The edit dialog's category combobox visually displayed the placeholder 'Select category' instead of the actual selected category (though the underlying hidden select still held the correct value). Updated only Description, Amount, and unmarked Tax Related without touching Category, then submitted. The resulting transaction retained the description/amount/tax changes correctly, but its Category was wiped to blank. Delete function worked correctly (row removed after confirmation).
evidence: Row after edit: 'Aug 25, 2026 QA Test Sale - Widget Order (Edited) [blank category] QA-REF-001 +$1,500.00 [no tax mark]'.

Created category 'QA Test Category' (Expense, Blue) -> appeared in Expense Categories list. Edited it to name 'QA Test Category Edited' with color Red -> list updated to new name. Deleted a category ('Software') -> it was removed from the Categories list.

issue: Deleting a category in use is not blocked and leaves transactions with blank category
actual: Deleted the 'Software' category which had 1 assigned transaction ('Software Subscription - Adobe CC'). The confirmation dialog explicitly stated 'Transactions using this category will not be deleted' with no reassignment option. After confirming deletion, the transaction now shows a blank Category cell instead of the original 'Software' or any 'Unknown' placeholder.
evidence: Transaction row after deletion: 'Dec 15, 2024 Software Subscription - Adobe CC [blank] — -$54.99 ✓'.

Search 'INV-001' returned exactly the transaction with that reference (Client Project - Website Redesign). Search 'Google Ads' returned exactly the transaction with matching description (Google Ads Campaign).

Combined filters applied incrementally: Type=Income (7 rows, all positive) -> +Category=Consulting (3 rows) -> +Date range Dec1-31,2024 (2 rows, correctly excluding Nov 15 entry) -> +Search='Strategy' (1 row: 'Consulting Fee - Strategy Session', Dec 8, INV-002, +$1,800.00). Totals recalculated correctly at each step. Clear Filters restored all 18 baseline transactions.

Transactions page supports independent and combined filtering by Type, Category, and Date range (From/To), each correctly narrowing the result set as verified during CS-12 testing (Type=Income->7 rows, +Category=Consulting->3 rows, +Date Dec1-31->2 rows).

issue: Invalid date range (From > To) not rejected with explanation
actual: Set From=2024-12-31 and To=2024-12-01 (From after To). The app did not reject the range or show any message explaining the range is invalid. Instead it silently applied the filter and displayed a generic 'No transactions found / Try adjusting your filters' empty state, indistinguishable from a valid filter that simply matches no rows.
evidence: Snapshot shows From textbox='2024-12-31', To textbox='2024-12-01', table replaced with 'No transactions found' / 'Try adjusting your filters' with no invalid-range-specific messaging.

Transaction table columns are Date, Description, Category, Reference, Amount, Tax, Actions — each row populated with these fields (e.g., 'Dec 8, 2024 | Consulting Fee - Strategy Session | Consulting | INV-002 | +$1,800.00 | ✓'). Below the table, 'Total Income' and 'Total Expenses' summary values recalculate to match the currently filtered result set (verified during CS-12 filter testing, e.g. totals changed from full-set totals to '+$1,800.00 / -$0.00' when filtered to 1 row).

Added an Aug 25, 2026 (current month) Income transaction '$250' via Add Transaction (SPA navigation, no reload) -> Dashboard Monthly Income/Net Profit-Loss immediately updated to $250 and the transaction appeared atop Recent Transactions, without any manual refresh. Edited the amount to $500 -> Dashboard Monthly Income/Net updated to $500 immediately. Deleted the transaction -> Dashboard Monthly Income/Net reverted to $0 and the transaction disappeared from Recent Transactions, all reflected instantly via client-side state updates.

issue: Total Balance does not reconcile with underlying transaction data
actual: Dashboard displays Total Balance='$74,931', but the sum of all visible transactions (Total Income +$47,592.50 minus Total Expenses -$36,485.99, from the Transactions page with all 18 baseline records) equals net $11,106.51 — a large unexplained discrepancy of ~$63,824. There is no starting-balance field, accounts page, or other UI element anywhere in the app disclosing this offset. All other Dashboard summary elements work correctly: Monthly Income/Monthly Expenses/Net Profit-Loss correctly compute to $0 for the current month (Aug 2026, no transactions) and update live when current-month transactions are added; Income vs Expenses chart and Expenses by Category chart are present and rendered; Recent Transactions list correctly shows the most recent transactions with description/category/date/amount.
evidence: Total Balance='$74,931'; Transactions page totals: Total Income='+$47,592.50', Total Expenses='-$36,485.99' (net $11,106.51) for the full unfiltered 18-row baseline dataset.

After adding a current-month (Aug 25, 2026) $175 Marketing expense, Dashboard Monthly Expenses/Net Profit-Loss and Recent Transactions updated immediately (verified during IX-16 sequence for an income transaction), and the Reports page for 'August 2026' correctly showed Total Income=$0, Total Expenses=$175, Net Profit/Loss=-$175, and 'Expenses by Category' breakdown listing 'Marketing $175' — all accurately reflecting the single underlying transaction.

issue: Chart axis labels lack precision to distinguish non-zero sub-$500 values from zero
actual: On the Reports page 'Daily Activity' chart for August 2026 (containing one real data point: a $175 expense on Aug 25), all 5 Y-axis tick labels read '$0k', identical to what a chart with zero data would show. Since the axis is scaled/labeled in whole thousands ('$Xk') with no decimal precision, any value under $500 (rounds to $0k) is visually indistinguishable from no data at all, making the chart misleading for typical small transactions.
evidence: Reports > August 2026 > Daily Activity chart Y-axis labels: '$0k','$0k','$0k','$0k','$0k' while Total Expenses for the period = $175 (Marketing category, single Aug 25 transaction).

Tax Summary for year 2024 shows Total Taxable Income=$47,592.50, Total Deductible Expenses=$36,485.99, Net Taxable Income=$11,106.51 — matching exactly the sum of all tax-related income/expense transactions. 'Taxable Income by Category' and 'Deductible Expenses by Category' tables break down correctly by category with accurate amounts/percentages (verified via manual sum, e.g. Sales Revenue=$36,750.00=77.2%, Salaries=$25,000.00=68.5%). 'All Tax-Related Transactions' table lists all 18 tax-marked transactions with date/description/category/reference/amount.

Clicked 'Print Report' on Tax Summary page (year 2024 selected). No JavaScript errors were raised (console: 0 errors, only pre-existing React Router/Dialog warnings unrelated to the click), the page remained on /tax-summary fully rendered with all data intact (Total Taxable Income $47,592.50 etc. unchanged), indicating the print action (window.print()) executed without an application error.

Edited 'Bank Interest' transaction (Dec 14, 2024) and unmarked its Tax Related switch (Update Income). Transactions list row lost its ✓ Tax mark. Navigating to Tax Summary (year 2024) then showed 'All Tax-Related Transactions' count dropped from 18 to 17 and no longer includes 'Bank Interest' in the list, confirming the tax-related toggle correctly controls both the transaction's tax status display and its inclusion in the annual tax summary.

After adding a new $175 'Marketing' expense transaction (CT22 Small Expense Test) on the Transactions page, the Categories page 'Marketing' card updated its transaction count from 1 to 2 and its Total from $850 to $1,025 ($850+$175), correctly and immediately reflecting the new categorized transaction without manual refresh (SPA navigation only).
